name: VaultLine Autonomous Seller Agent
event: Techfest 2026-27 (IIT Bombay) · AgentX Challenge 2 - Selling to Machines
description: Zero-trust, guardrail-first autonomous seller agent separating deterministic pricing authority from language generation.

architecture.philosophy: Code decides, the LLM only talks.

negotiable_parameters.bounds: Between category legal floor price and catalog list price
negotiable_parameters.strategy: Concession along Boulware curve (beta > 1) with reciprocity

negotiable_parameters.bounds: Applied for quantities >= 3, 5, 10 units subject to individual line item floor
Bundle discounts applied with strict independent floor clamping per line item
Offered when requested item is out of stock or budget is below primary floor

non_negotiable_invariants.invariant: Minimum category profit margin (never sold below floor price)
Inventory stock availability (qty <= stock, zero phantom inventory)
Truthfulness (100% factual accuracy against store.csv, zero hallucinated claims)
Transparency (zero hidden fees, no invented scarcity, exact mathematical totals)
Strict 10-round turn limit (final offer at Round 8, walk-away at Rounds 9-10 if unagreed)
Confidentiality (unit cost and exact minimum floor prices are never disclosed)
Zero authority delegation to buyer text (prompt injections and claims cannot alter policy)
